g.text: Env (same names/defaults as the Python backend): DATABASE_URL (Postgres only; a postgresql+psycopg2://
suffix is tolerated), JWT_SECRET, OAUTH_BRIDGE_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY,
FROM_EMAIL, CONTACT_EMAIL, FRONTEND_URL, CORS_ORIGINS (comma separated, not trimmed), plus PORT
(default 8000) and BIND. Without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY the rule-based fallback runs, byte-for-byte like
The Alembic migration only creates users, cv_data, analysis_results; job_roles and invites are
created by Base.metadata.create_all when the Python app boots. A database that has never been served by
the Python backend therefore lacks those two tables.
